recent_excerpts: NCSC, FBI and AIVD warn that Iranian state actors use CHOSEN BRICK malware, delivered via WhatsApp and Telegram social engineering, to spy on dissidents and journalists.
NCSC, FBI and AIVD joint advisory details CHOSEN BRICK, Windows spyware Iranian state actors use to surveil dissidents, activists and journalists via WhatsApp and Telegram...
Security researchers uncovered 'Fast16,' a pre-Stuxnet sabotage malware that targeted high-precision calculation software in Iran, tampering with results and self-propagating.
